added.name: Animals
added.desc:
animals can be found around the map, with each having unique interactions and small chances of doing something

## Dogs

- **You can pet dogs** They will Follow you around temporarily once you pet them
- **Dogs interaction with crows** Crows that mess with dogs, surrounding the dog and bothering it
- **Dogs interaction with crows 2** Crows can ride the dogs
- **Dogs interaction with cats** The dogs can BARK at cats when too close, they can chase one another shortly.
- **Dogs interaction to attacks** The dogs will BITE you. 5 bites per dog, If another dog is nearby they can team up on you.
- **dogs can be seen with different variants**
- **Dog idle** They stretch, lick themselves, sit, etc.
  ![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aefc388e72666e35afd52b7/attachments/6aefc6b6e7d0f07a59442d92/previews/6aefc6b6e7d0f07a59442dc2/download/image.webp)
  ![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aefc388e72666e35afd52b7/attachments/6aefc669c780667c36eaee35/previews/6aefc66ac780667c36eaef04/download/image.webp)

## Cats

- **Initial approach** Running towards a cat too close will make it hiss at you or make it back up.
- **You can pet cats** Nothing happens when you pet them AFAIK, but petting them TOO much will make them bite you once.
- **Cats interaction with dogs** If a dog is following you, cats will run away after hissing at you.
- **Cats interaction with crows** Not found
- **Cats Variety** 2 cat varieties Found
- **Idle stance** Stretching, cleaning themselves, sleep, etc.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aefc388e72666e35afd52b7/attachments/6aefc6e2b4ff4a093c00fc63/previews/6aefc6e2b4ff4a093c00fcaa/download/image.webp)

![Screenshot\_2026-11-08\_024827.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aefc388e72666e35afd52b7/attachments/6aefc6ebc48771fcaa6903a6/previews/6aefc6ecc48771fcaa6904a2/download/Screenshot_2026-11-08_024827.webp)

‌

## Crows

- **Crows will "respect" you if you die.**
- **You can FEED the crows, it will say you're on their good side.**
- **Crows will gather on top of you if you are idle long enough.**
- **There’s a really small chance of them taking you to their king.**
- **Crows can pick you up and play around with you in the air.**
  Crows can mess around with other animals and cats are able to “jump” them


![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aefc388e72666e35afd52b7/attachments/6aefc52378bc63b8ee507a0a/previews/6aefc52378bc63b8ee507a21/download/image.webp)

added.name: QOL Update #5
added.desc:
## ✨ New

```diff
+ 4 new V2 styles: mishima, ali (ippo), perfect copy & dragon (master the style to unlock)
   + perfect copy V2 has an air crit (jump + heavy) & can jump while in combat

+ stray dogs & cats around the streets (pet them & they tag along)

+ crows on poles, wires & trash cans (feed them, befriend them... or get on their bad side)

+ public private servers (put your server on the server list so anyone can join, with tags, a custom look & likes)
+ battle royale, infection & tug of war game modes for private servers
+ new dunks (power jam, one hander, tomahawk, windmill & lefty) & hang on the rim after a dunk
+ hair swap (players with pastel pink or glacier blue hair can swap with each other)
+ rep in playerlist (like or dislike players with a reason)
+ a 3rd fighting style slot & up to 5 uniform slots
+ halloween recap & locker: pick which halloween fits, styles & faces to keep wearing (menu > halloween)
+ update log on the loading screen (click it to read this & older updates)
```

## ⚔ Combat / balance

```diff
+ V2 crits have aura flares, hand & foot trails, camera hits, slow-mo finishers & dust/rubble that match the ground
+ 1 second of iframes after a grapple or getting up from ragdoll from other players
- getting hit in the air no longer ragdolls you
- tall characters' damage buff from last update reverted (reach & health stay)
# attacks look more synced for parrying
# losing a grapple shoves you farther away (so you don't get comboed right after)
# fixed being able to hit someone instantly after winning a grapple
# fixed m1 swing sounds playing late
# fixed your first combo anims looking broken after joining or switching style
# fixed finishers bending your legs into the ground
# fixed grab m2s flinging players with pvp off
# fixed bodies getting stuck mid pose or bouncing around after crits
```

## 🔑 Private servers

```diff
+ templates (copy another server's roles & settings with a code, or share yours)
+ event tools (event teams with jerseys, a timer & an info board everyone sees)
+ click a player to kick, give roles, bring, freeze & more (shift + click to pick several)
+ lock players inside an area (areas tab)
+ spectator mode (can't be hit, free camera anywhere)
+ action log (see who kicked, banned or joined)
+ change how much a knockdown heals (server tab)
+ turn npcs & cars on or off (npcs tab)
# commands panel is a window you can drag & resize
# fixed fly on mobile
# fixed others seeing you stand still while you fly
# fixed turf war spawning people inside walls
- removed the old skatepark from the areas list
```

## 🎤 Social / music / profile

```diff
+ 6 new rhythm songs:
   + Creeping Death (Metallica), Hero (Primary, y2l), Kiss The Ladder Guitar (Fleshwater), Looping the Rooms (Rusino, Hatsune Miku), Murder Melody (Calt To Follow), Never Fade Away (Samurai)
+ top sort in the rhythm song wheel & top songs in the phone music app (most played across every server)
+ rhythm results show how many players you beat
+ 1v1 win rate for every fight style in stats
# faces are sharp instead of pixelated
# fixed piggyback riders making footsteps
# fixed holding hands, carry & duo emotes at different heights looking weird
# fixed the music room bass anim making the bass float
# song wheel on controller no longer plays a different song than the one under your cursor
- chat no longer adds question marks to your messages by itself
```

## 🏀 Basketball

```diff
+ bullet passing (pass while sprinting, normal overhead pass now only when not sprinting)
+ rims & backboards react (shake on misses, bend when you dunk or hang on rim)
+ pump fakes (was missing an animation for it)
# defense counts a lot more (contests work from arm's length)
# steals & blocks land more often
# eurosteps no longer force a layup (can shoot, pumpfake, dunk, etc)
# fading out of bounds or over half court on a jumpshot is legal
# fadeaways glide reduced by 25%
# being heavily contested or more will make you fall over
- cant contest a shot for 1s after a block attempt
# fixed shoot spam restarting your shot meter
# fixed shot clock vio being called while the shot is in the air
# fixed being able to dribble during free throws
# fixed passes & inbounds to a close teammate going straight through them
# fixed not being able to catch a give-and-go right after passing
# fixed greens getting called a bit early or late
# fixed dribbling for tall & short players (ball follows your hands)
# fixed getting stuck with an invisible ball after a backcourt catch
# fixed not being able to grab close misses off the rim right away
```

## 🏐 Volleyball

```diff
+ teammates who jump into each other both fall over
+ the ball squashes & stretches again (without the lag)
# stamina comes back 2.5x faster
- no more sprint gliding on front row jumps
# fixed jumping way too high after emotes or getting hit
```

## 🏆 All sports

```diff
# sports stat sheets now also show ur roblox user
# goal effect sfx improved (sparkle, blaze, thunder, frost, sakura, tempest, meteor & supernova)
```

## 🌸 World

```diff
+ cinematic camera on taxi rides
# traffic unjams itself (cars back up to let each other through)
# fixed cars machine gunning their horn
# fixed cars ragdolling people they never actually hit
# fixed npcs spawning under the map by club akuma
# fixed skateboard crashes flinging you & tearing your body apart
# fixed closed trash bins not opening (console)
```

## ⚡ Performance

```diff
# fixed one cause of long freezes that got worse the longer you stayed in a server
# optimization for sports
# smoother fps on older pcs around town (most of all the soccer stadium)
# fixed small lag spikes from cars driving off & gripping knocked players
```

## 🔧 Fixes

```diff
# fixed a black line on hands in the default male uniform
# fixed two jump buttons showing on mobile
# fixed your jump sometimes getting stuck as a tiny hop
# fixed stats (and other uis) staying in dark mode after switching night theme off
# fixed knocked players standing back up while still knocked
# fixed the screen staying blurry after a menu closed mid opening
# fixed picking up someone's knocked off accessory dragging you into the ground or making you carry them
# fixed placing food saying "no room" when there's room (and it now says why when you can't)
# uniform page no longer covers the perks page after a badly timed click
# no-chat icon only shows over people whose messages you really can't see
```
